threat_event: A phished engineer's credentials are used to reach group and client station networks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Engineers hold accounts at group stations and use client-issued remote access
owner: Engineering and Radiation Services security and compliance lead

threat_event: SGI is disclosed to a person without a documented need-to-know
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 31 contractor engineers without documented determinations; access list not reconciled since 2025-Q3
existing_controls: Background checks and FBI fingerprinting for SGI access

threat_event: SGI copied on a networked scanner remains in device storage or is sent over the network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One office used a networked scanner for SGI
treatment_plan: Stand-alone copier for SGI; wipe and evaluate the device; retrain

threat_event: Contractor/vendor access authorization files for about 2,900 outage workers are stolen from project shares
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Files readable by project teams (73.56(m)); shares reachable with one engineer's identity
treatment_plan: Move files to a restricted repository owned by the access authorization program; access review

threat_event: Ransomware on the dosimetry system halts dose processing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single production environment; lab network connected to the corporate network
treatment_plan: Segment the lab network; quarterly restore test

threat_event: A customer administrator account on the dosimetry portal is taken over and dose records are read
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Customer administrators sign in with a password only
treatment_plan: MFA for customer administrators; then all customer users

threat_event: A dose calculation software error releases incorrect results
treatment_plan: Map NVLAP checks to processing integrity criteria (P09)

threat_event: Client engineering data, including CDA designs, leaks from the collaboration platform
treatment_plan: Restrict external sharing for CDA-related projects; quarterly review
owner: Engineering and Radiation Services chief engineer

threat_event: A contract notice to dosimetry customers or utility clients is late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 72-hour customer terms not in the group matrix
owner: Engineering and Radiation Services security and compliance lead

threat_event: FCI from DOE projects is handled outside the enclave
treatment_plan: DLP rule for DOE project markings

threat_event: Part 810 technology is accessed by an unauthorized foreign person
The single background investigation vendor is breached or unavailable during outage season
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 80% of contractor/vendor files go through one vendor
treatment_plan: Qualify a second vendor; review the vendor's SOC 2 report

threat_event: Generative AI output enters safety-related engineering work without quality assurance controls
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Engineers use an approved generative AI assistant; no QA rule for its use
regulatory_driver: 10 CFR Part 50, Appendix B (through client contracts)
existing_controls: Group AI Standard; human checking of calculations
treatment_plan: QA procedure for AI use; prohibit for safety-related calculations until approved (P10)
owner: Engineering and Radiation Services chief engineer

threat_event: Laptops returned from client sites keep client data
owner: Engineering and Radiation Services security and compliance lead

threat_event: An insider sells client security engineering data
treatment_plan: User behavior analytics on SYS-E1 security projects

threat_event: An SGI stand-alone workstation is connected to a network for patching
treatment_plan: Offline patch procedure with removable media scanning
